decisions.reason: The accepted first-mint exception changes the metadata accounting rule: when no earlier NFT holder exists, the first no-code mint cannot produce a randomly allocated ticket or $5 commission to display.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yeah, that’s fine, since it’s a one-off and won’t have any impact going forward.

value_updates.ticket_and_commission_attribute_accounti: Each completed mint must be reflected in the recipient NFT's attributes as one ticket and one $5 commission, credited to the code-selected NFT when a referral code is used or to the randomly selected NFT when no referral code is used, except for the first mint when no earlier NFT holder exists; that mint produces no randomly allocated ticket or commission.

decisions.reason: The one-off first-mint allocation exception does not change NFT transfer behavior, transferred referral-code ownership, or the recipient of later commissions earned through a transferred NFT's referral code.
